claims.claim: The rigid bottle matches the requested identity, size, and parts.
claims.evidence: request.md requests decor/bottle_assembly, rigid, 0.07 x 0.07 x 0.295 m. asset/provenance.json identifies the same instance and prop class; asset/asset.json declares rigid. probes/02_geometry.out measures mesh bounds [-0.035,-0.035,0] to [0.035,0.035,0.29500005] m. All four renders show the neutral whitebox bottle with body, label band, neck, and cap.

claims.claim: Collision boxes cover the visible parts without blocking a required opening.
claims.evidence: readings.json collision_boxes and probes/02_geometry.out: body 0.068 x 0.068 x 0.24 m at z=0..0.24; label 0.07 x 0.07 x 0.06 at z=0.10..0.16; neck 0.034 x 0.034 x 0.035 at z=0.24..0.275; cap 0.038 x 0.038 x 0.02 at z=0.275..0.295. renders/front.png, side.png, top.png and iso.png show corresponding solid parts. Boxes conservatively approximate the round cross-sections with square corners; there is no required cavity or access opening. Label/body overlap is within the single rigid link.

claims.claim: Joint travel, attachment, and inter-link interference requirements are satisfied as not applicable.
claims.evidence: readings.json joints is empty; asset/model.urdf contains only link body and no joints, confirmed by probes/02_geometry.out joint_count: 0. probes/01_settle.out reports joints {} and overlaps [] throughout.

claims.claim: Handle grasp-and-pull requirements are satisfied as not applicable.
claims.evidence: request.md requires no handles; readings.json handles is empty. The maximum bottle width is 0.07 m, below the stated 0.08 m gripper opening.

claims.claim: Place-target resting requirements are satisfied as not applicable.
claims.evidence: request.md requires no place targets; readings.json place_targets is empty.

claims.claim: The free rigid bottle settles on the ground and remains upright.
claims.evidence: probes/01_settle.py uses Probe("asset", fixed=False). probes/01_settle.out at cumulative 30, 150 and 300 frames (1, 5 and 10 seconds) reports unchanged position [0,0,0.14747] and identity rotation, after initial reported z=0.1475. Four ground/body contacts each carry 1.418 N, totaling 5.672 N, consistent with the declared 0.578 kg mass. The reported box_world heights are offset by the inertial-origin height and are not used as ground-clearance evidence; the contacts and unchanged upright rotation establish settling.
